floors.title: Wooden floors
floors.short: Parquet, planks and laminate – laid, sanded and sealed.
floors.description: Placeholder text: We lay parquet, solid wood planks and laminate on any subfloor. This includes screed preparation, sound insulation, skirting boards and, on request, sanding and sealing old floors.

tiles.title: Tiles
tiles.short: Bathrooms, kitchens and floors – precisely tiled, cleanly grouted.
tiles.description: Placeholder text: Whether it's a bathroom renovation, a kitchen backsplash or large-format floor tiles – we work to the millimetre, waterproof properly and advise you on materials and patterns.

plaster.title: Plastering
plaster.short: Smooth walls and ceilings – interior plaster at every finish level.
plaster.description: Placeholder text: We plaster walls and ceilings with lime, gypsum or cement plaster, skim to a perfect finish and prepare everything for paint or wallpaper.

painting.title: Painting
painting.short: Fresh colour indoors – carefully masked, evenly painted.
painting.description: Placeholder text: We paint walls, ceilings, doors and radiators, hang wallpaper and help you choose colours. Furniture and floors are carefully protected.

drywall.title: Drywall
drywall.short: New walls, suspended ceilings and loft conversions.
drywall.description: Placeholder text: With drywall we re-divide rooms, convert lofts, install suspended ceilings and integrate lighting – fast, clean and without long drying times.

about.title: Craftsmanship with responsibility
about.text: Placeholder text: I have been renovating flats and houses for many years. I plan every project personally, keep to agreed dates and tell you honestly what makes sense – and what doesn't.
